coach.label: Your coach
coach.welcome.title: Welcome to Trail Manager!
coach.welcome.text: I'm your coach. I'll be here to help you build your trail running career.
coach.start.title: One step at a time
coach.start.text: You don't need to learn everything today. I'll explain things as you need them. Let's prepare your first week!
coach.tip.attributes.title: Your attributes
coach.tip.attributes.text: Here are your runner's attributes. They grow as you train and with the points you earn when you level up.
coach.tip.condition.title: Fitness and Fatigue
coach.tip.condition.text: Fitness is your form: it rises with training and drops if you stop. Fatigue builds up with every session and rest brings it down. Too much Fatigue can end in an injury.
coach.tip.plan.title: Let's plan your week
coach.tip.plan.text: Tap Training to plan your first week.
coach.tip.week.title: Your week
coach.tip.week.text: Each week has seven days. Tap a day to see it or plan it ahead.
coach.tip.session.title: Choose a session
coach.tip.session.text: Pick today's session. You'll see what it gives in XP, Fitness and Fatigue, and which attribute it trains.
coach.tip.complete.title: Complete the day
coach.tip.complete.text: When you're ready, complete the day. Mix hard sessions with rest to keep Fatigue under control.
coach.tip.firstWeek.title: First week done!
coach.tip.firstWeek.text: Great work. Now it's time to test yourself: tap Races.
coach.tip.raceList.title: Choose a race
coach.tip.raceList.text: Pick a race open to your level and enter it: it is run on Sunday, one race per week. Keep training during the week to arrive in shape.
coach.tip.intensity.title: Set your pace
coach.tip.intensity.text: Choose how hard to run the first segment. A faster pace saves time but tires you more for the rest of the race.
coach.tip.nutrition.title: Gels and bars
coach.tip.nutrition.text: If you have them, take an energy gel or a cereal bar to keep going. You can buy packs in the Equipment shop.
coach.tip.startRace.title: Ready to start
coach.tip.startRace.text: Start the race. At every aid station you can change your pace again.
coach.tip.firstRace.title: Your first race!
coach.tip.firstRace.text: Well done on finishing it. Your results, ranking and challenges are in Career: tap Career.
coach.tip.career.title: Your career
coach.tip.career.text: Here you follow your ranking against runners from around the world, your challenges and your races. See you on the trails!
